attackers_goals: Impersonate the node agent to gain control over the cluster.
description: A process accessed both the Kubelet credentials and the Kubernetes CA certificate, indicating an attempt to impersonate the node agent and communicate with the API server.
detector_tags: Kubernetes - AGENT, Kubernetes Credentials Theft Analytics
investigative_actions: Look for additional suspicious activities. Verify if the exposed credentials were used to access the API server. Investigate which operations were used against the Kubernetes cluster with the exposed credentials.
name: Potential kubelet impersonation attempt
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
